JojaMart’s E, F, and H aisles stock [color=#6d9eeb]JojaFresh[/color]™ products! 
[b]

• [b]9[color=#9fc5e8] [/color][color=#6d9eeb]JojaFresh[/color][/b] Salads [/b]that cycle flavors depending on the season.[b]

[b] ﻿[/b][/b]-[b] [/b]Comes at the cost of reducing your Combat Skill.[b]

﻿- +3 [/b]buffs to non-combat skills for[b] 3 minutes[/b] for a moderate cost[b]. [/b]No [b][b]Health [/b][/b]OR [b][b]Energy[/b][/b] restoring though![b]
[b][b] [/b][/b][/b]﻿- Comes at the cost of [b]reducing [/b]your other non-combat skills by [b]-1[/b].[b]
[b][b] ﻿[/b][/b][/b]- [b]Custom [color=#6d9eeb]JojaFresh [/color]buff IDs[/b]. Meaning [b]these do not take up a [b]traditional [/b]food buff slot[/b]. They'll only overwrite other[b] [color=#6d9eeb]JojaFresh [/color]buffs[/b]!

[/b]
Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37717]JojaPantry [/url]for canned produce, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38939]JojaMills Breakfast[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37365]JojaSweets Candy[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38012]JojaFizzy Energy Drinks[/url], or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37232]JojaBite TV Dinners [/url]for more Joja snacks!

There's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39109]JojaGrowth Fertilizer[/url] for your fields, or even [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38103]JojaFlex - Freelance Contracts[/url] if you'd like a side job!

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• SpaceCore

Doesn't edit the JojaMart map. Should be compatible with mods that edit the store, as long as they don't remove/relocate the aisles of the store.
Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. (Used in Screenshots. Also in screenshot: Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn + SVE patch., VPR-Inspired UI)
